_provenance.source: arbitrum mainnet, unfiltered eth_getTransactionReceipt for two GMX V2 keeper transactions
_provenance.why: VIB-6061 - the keeper execution fee is the dominant native cost of a GMX order and appeared nowhere in the books. These receipts carry the KeeperExecutionFee / ExecutionFeeRefund pair the Cost Stack now books.
_provenance.note: UNFILTERED on purpose. The existing gmx_keeper_receipts_arbitrum.json keeps only the 3 logs its assertions need; the execution-fee guards are about which logs are ABSENT or DUPLICATED, so a pre-filtered receipt could not exercise them.
